description: Core IPC and event permissions for the main Aulora window and the separate call picture-in-picture window. Native features (badge, notifications, deep links, the call window, its frame channel) are exposed only through the shell's own commands, so no plugin JS permissions are granted. Drag and resize regions in the webview need the window start-dragging and start-resize-dragging permissions: the main window's title bar and the call window's header both use drag regions, and the undecorated call window resizes from its own edge handles.
